title: cleome hochstetteri
intro: Cleome hochstetteri, commonly known as the Spider Flower, is a flowering plant species native to Mexico. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its reported health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cleome hochstetteri include its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its use as an antiseptic and antispasmodic. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
